chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abu Abdullah al-Mumin, from Is'haq ibn Ammar, who said:

I heard him (peace be upon him) saying, and people were asking him, saying: 'The livelihoods are distributed on the night of the middle of Shaban.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'No, by Allah! That is not except during the night of the nineteenth of the month of Ramadan, and the twenty-first, and the twenty-third. For indeed, on the night of the nineteenth, the two parties meet; and on the night of the twenty-first, every wise affair is distinguished; and on the night of the twenty-third, whatever Allah, Mighty and Majestic, intended from that is accomplished, and it is the Night of Predestination of which Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said: Better than a thousand months.'

He (the narrator) said, 'I said, 'What is the meaning of His saying: 'The two parties meet'?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Allah gathers therein whatever He intended from its bringing forward, and its delaying, and His intention, and His judgement.'

He (the narrator) said, 'I said, 'So what is the meaning of 'It is accomplished on the twenty-third'?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'It is distinguished on the night of the twenty-first, and there happens to be the Change (al-Bada') with regards to it. So when it is the night of the twenty-third, He accomplishes it, so it becomes from the inevitable, there be no change for it from the Blessed and High.'
ai.seo_question: When are the livelihoods distributed according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi corrects the popular misconception that sustenance is distributed on the 15th of Shaban, locating the divine decree instead within the final ten nights of Ramadan. It elucidates the nuanced Shia theological concept of *al-Bada'* (divine changeability), explaining that while affairs are distinguished on the 21st night, they remain subject to alteration until the 23rd night, when they are finally sealed as immutable destiny. This progression highlights the dynamic nature of God's will before the finalization of the Night of Power.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Abu Abdullah Al Momin, from Is’haq Bin Ammar who said,

‘I heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying, and the people were saying that the livelihoods are distributed during the night of the middle of Shaban, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! That is not except during the night of the 19<sup>th</sup> of a Month of Ramazan, and 21<sup>st</sup>, and 23<sup>rd</sup>. So, during the night of the 19<sup>th</sup> the two parties meet; and during the night of the 21<sup>st</sup>, every wise affair is Made to be distinct; and during the night of the 23<sup>rd</sup> whatever Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has Intended, gets accomplished, and it is the Night of Pre-destination of which Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic has Said it is better than a thousand months’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘I said, ‘What is the Meaning of Hisazwj Worlds [8:41] the day on which the two parties meet?’ Heasws said: ‘Allahazwj Gathers therein whatever Heazwj so Intends from its Bringing forward, and its Delaying, and Hisazwj intention, and Hisazwj Judgement’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘I said, ‘So what is the meaning of ‘It gets accomplished during the 23<sup>rd</sup>?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is Made to be distinct during the night of the 21<sup>st</sup>, and there happens to be the Change with regards to it. So when it is the night of the 23<sup>rd</sup>, it gets accomplished, so it happens to be from the inevitable, there be no change for it from the Blessed and High’.
en.sarwar: 8. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from abu ‘Abd Allah al-Mu’min from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following:

“I heard him (the Imam) say- when people said, “Sustenance is divided during the night in the middle of the month of Sha‘ban”-, ‘No, by Allah, that is in no other time besides the nineteenth night of the month of Ramadan, or the twenty-first or twenty-third night of this month. During the nineteenth night of this month, two groups meet; in the twenty-first night, all matters of wisdom are differentiated; and in the twenty-third night, whatever Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Glorious, wishes of such matters is approved. It is the night of destiny about which Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Glorious, has said, . . the night of destiny is better than one thousand months.’”

He (the narrator) has said, ‘I then asked about the meaning of his words, “Two groups meet”?’ He (the Imam) replied, ‘Allah brings together in that night what He has decided, in matters to be brought forward or delayed, to decide or to approve it.’

I then said, ‘What is the meaning of, “approves it during the twenty-third night”?’ He (the Imam) replied, ‘During the twenty-first night, He differentiates the rule. Then al- Bada’ may take place, therefore, in the twenty-third night is the approval and thus it becomes inevitable in such issues where al-Bada’ does not happen, Allah is most Blessed, the most High.’”
